messages.subject: GCC Energy & Infrastructure Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mahmood,

Ascendia Group's work across energy, renewables, utilities and infrastructure in the Middle East makes this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates in Saudi Arabia and the UAE where growth requires strong public-sector engagement, regulatory credibility and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
